goal: Deliver the accepted model as an inspected interactive HTML viewer with orbit/zoom
preconditions: Final exported model and renderer output have been reviewed
Viewer serves only intended publication files
steps: Use a verified Tailscale URL under the user delivery rules
Load the real exported model, inspect silhouette/materials, rotate and zoom
Inspect desktop and narrow viewport; no clipped or unavailable controls
Link the .blend/model and original render when useful; keep operational logs out of the user interface
checks: Actual model loaded, no fabricated fallback geometry
Orbit and zoom visibly change the view
Viewer has no failed asset requests; accepted files are the files served
limits: This is a delivery checklist, not an executable renderer
Browser inspection is mandatory before claiming the viewer is ready
validation: Checklist exercised on actual exported lamp geometry in a Tailscale HTML viewer; desktop/mobile, rotate/zoom, Spanish persistence and asset loading checked.
